repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于手机的语音AI客服代理。Twilio通过WebSocket将实时通话音频流传输至该FastAPI服务；在每个交互轮次中，该服务会进行语音转文本（STT）→ 从RAG知识库中检索答案 → 借助大型语言模型（LLM）进行推理 → 通过语音转文本（TTS）进行语音输出，形成一个流式循环。

repositories.description: Developed an AI-powered voice-based sales agent using Python, Flask, Twilio API, and Speech Recognition. Automated outbound calls, answered customer queries using a knowledge base, and assisted with demo bookings. Supports English and Telugu conversations through NLP and REST API integration.
repositories.descriptionZh: 利用 Python、Flask、Twilio API 和语音识别技术，开发了一款基于人工智能的语音销售代理。该系统可自动发起外呼，通过知识库回答客户咨询，并协助安排产品演示预约。通过自然语言处理（NLP）和 REST API 集成，支持英语和泰卢固语的对话。

repositories.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that answers customer questions (shipping, returns, payments, account, orders, support, discounts, warranty, and more) grounded in a FAQ knowledge base, with an honest fallback when it doesn't know something.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于常见问题解答（FAQ）知识库的检索增强生成（RAG）聊天机器人，可回答客户的问题（包括物流、退货、支付、账户、订单、客服、折扣、保修等），当无法回答时会诚实地告知“无法提供该信息”。

repositories.description: An AI-first support operations platform that autonomously resolves customer tickets in real-time. repositories.description: CyberShield is a Python tool that detects suspicious activity using predefined rules and risk levels. Its desktop interface displays alerts and history, while SQLite stores records for review. The project demonstrates cybersecurity monitoring, Python programming, and database management in practice.
repositories.descriptionZh: CyberShield 是一款 Python 工具，它利用预定义的规则和风险等级来检测可疑活动。其桌面界面用于显示警报和历史记录，而 SQLite 则用于存储供后续审查的记录。该项目展示了网络安全监控、Python 编程和数据库管理的实际应用。

repositories.description: Microsoft Azure practical guide covering compute services, Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, disks, storage accounts, Azure Monitor, alerts, Log Analytics, and Backup. Learn cloud infrastructure deployment, networking, storage management, monitoring, and disaster recovery through hands-on projects.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一本涵盖 Microsoft Azure 计算服务、虚拟机、虚拟网络、磁盘、存储帐户、Azure Monitor、警报、日志分析以及备份的实用指南。通过动手实践项目，学习云基础设施部署、网络配置、存储管理、监控和灾难恢复。

repositories.description: An intuitive Expense Tracker that empowers users to monitor daily spending, set budget goals, and visualize financial habits with real-time analytics. Features instant transaction logging, category breakdowns, and smart budget alerts to make personal money management effortless and stress-free.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款直观的开支追踪应用，帮助用户监控日常开支、设定预算目标，并通过实时分析直观呈现财务习惯。该应用具备即时交易记录、分类明细和智能预算提醒等功能，让个人理财变得轻松无压力。

repositories.description: AI-powered construction monitoring SaaS that tracks progress, budgets, and delays in real time, with BOQ management, smart alerts, delay prediction, and Claude-generated project summaries. Built on Angular 21, .NET 10, and MySQL.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于人工智能的建筑监理SaaS平台，可实时跟踪工程进度、预算和延误情况，并具备工程量清单管理、智能提醒、延误预测以及由Claude生成的项目摘要等功能。该平台基于Angular 21、.NET 10和MySQL构建。

repositories.description: Network Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Simulation — A defensive cybersecurity project for synthetic network-flow monitoring, hybrid intrusion detection, risk scoring, alert management, and SOC-style investigation.
repositories.descriptionZh: 网络入侵检测系统（IDS）仿真——一个旨在实现合成网络流量监控、混合入侵检测、风险评分、警报管理以及SOC风格调查的网络安全防御项目。

repositories.description: This project uses YOLOv8-based computer vision technology to detect products on retail shelves, identify empty shelf gaps, and count available items. It automatically generates low-stock alerts, helping retailers improve inventory management and reduce manual monitoring efforts.
repositories.descriptionZh: 该项目利用基于YOLOv8的计算机视觉技术，检测零售货架上的商品、识别空缺位置并统计可用商品数量。它能自动生成库存不足警报，帮助零售商优化库存管理并减少人工监控工作量。

repositories.description: CloudTask is a cloud-based task management REST API built with Python Flask and Microsoft Azure. It uses Azure App Service, SQL Database, Blob Storage, Queue Storage, and Key Vault, with managed identity, RBAC, monitoring, alerting, and governance features for secure and maintainable cloud application design.
repositories.descriptionZh: CloudTask 是一个基于云的任务管理 REST API，采用 Python Flask 和 Microsoft Azure 构建。它使用 Azure 应用服务、SQL 数据库、Blob 存储、队列存储和密钥库，并具备托管身份、基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）、监控、警报和治理功能，以实现安全且易于维护的云应用程序设计。

repositories.description: StockWise is a smart grocery inventory and Point of Sale (POS) management system built to simplify retail store operations. It provides product catalog management, batch-wise stock tracking, expiry date monitoring, low-stock alerts, barcode-based product lookup, stock receiving, sales processing, and dashboard analytics. The project aims to improve
repositories.descriptionZh: StockWise 是一款智能杂货库存和销售点（POS）管理系统，旨在简化零售店的运营。它提供产品目录管理、按批次库存跟踪、保质期监控、库存不足提醒、基于条形码的产品查询、入库管理、销售处理以及仪表盘分析等功能。该项目旨在提升

repositories.description: BloodBridge is a technology-driven blood management platform designed to help improve blood availability by supporting blood demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, low-stock alerts, and donor matching. The project integrates machine learning techniques, including XGBoost, to analyze historical blood demand data and predict future requirements.
repositories.descriptionZh: BloodBridge 是一个以技术为驱动的血液管理平台，旨在通过支持血液需求预测、库存监控、库存不足预警以及捐献者匹配等功能，帮助提高血液供应量。该项目整合了包括 XGBoost 在内的机器学习技术，用于分析历史血液需求数据并预测未来需求。

repositories.description: CityTrack AI is an AI-powered platform for monitoring government infrastructure projects. It enables real-time tracking, budget and milestone management, GPS-based field updates, and photo uploads. AI predicts delays, identifies risks, and suggests corrective actions. Analytics, alerts, and reports support faster, data-driven decisions.
repositories.descriptionZh: CityTrack AI 是一个基于人工智能的政府基础设施项目监控平台。它支持实时跟踪、预算和里程碑管理、基于 GPS 的现场更新以及照片上传。人工智能可预测延误、识别风险并建议纠正措施。分析、警报和报告有助于更快地做出数据驱动的决策。

repositories.description: MotorVibe demonstrates a full-stack web application for industrial motor condition monitoring. Its dashboard combines plant overview, motor management, live telemetry, alerts, maintenance planning and reports in one interface. The project uses a React and TypeScript frontend with a Node.js and Express backend and a PostgreSQL database.
repositories.descriptionZh: MotorVibe 展示了一个用于工业电机状态监测的全栈 Web 应用程序。其仪表盘将工厂概览、电机管理、实时遥测、警报、维护计划和报告整合到一个界面中。该项目采用 React 和 TypeScript 构建前端，Node.js 和 Express 构建后端，并使用 PostgreSQL 数据库。

repositories.description: A robust, real-time inventory management system designed to track stock levels, monitor product movement, and automate low-stock alerts. This project streamlines supply chain operations by providing a centralized dashboard to manage items, categories, and stock history, minimizing manual data entry errors and preventing stockouts.
repositories.descriptionZh: 这是一个功能强大的实时库存管理系统，旨在追踪库存水平、监控产品流动并自动触发低库存警报。该项目通过提供一个集中式仪表盘来管理商品、类别和库存历史，从而优化供应链运营，最大限度地减少人工录入错误，并防止缺货。
